nuclear_vq_embolism.author: Westgate EJ, FitzGerald GA
nuclear_vq_embolism.description:
Ventilation-perfusion scintigraphy in a woman taking oral contraceptives and valdecoxib.(A) After inhalation of 20.1 mCi of Xenon-133 gas, scintigraphic images were obtained in the posterior projection, showing uniform ventilation to lungs.
(B) After intravenous injection of 4.1 mCi of Technetium-99m-labeled macroaggregated albumin, scintigraphic images were obtained, shown here in the posterior projection. This and other views showed decreased activity in the following regions: apical segment of right upper lobe, anterior segment of right upper lobe, superior segment of right lower lobe, posterior basal segment of right lower lobe, anteromedial basal segment of left lower lobe, and lateral basal segment of left lower lobe.

mri_l4_l5_disc_herniation.description: LUMBAR SPINE MRI Indication Left lower back pain. Technique Sequence in T1 and T2 Dixon sagittal slices and a 3D T2 sequence in axial slices. Normal morphology of posterior joints. At L1-L2, L2-L3 and L3-L4 levels Minimal disc protrusion overall, with no focal protrusion or root impingement. The lateral foramen are free. At L5-S1' Global disc overhang predominantly right paramedian, with no obvious radicular impingement. The lateral foramen are free. mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc.author: Jian-Min Shen, Xian-Wu Xia, Wu-Gen Kang, Jian-Jun Yuan and Liang Sheng
mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc.description: Different sequences of MRI taken in a case 4 hours after cerebral infarction : T2 weighted , which failed to diagnose the infarcted region Diffusion weighted image (DWI), with clear infarcted region in basal ganglia. ADC image , showing lower ADC value in infarcted region.
mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc.visible_identifiers: None observed in local visual review
mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc.source_plane: Axial brain ADC map, visually verified from the ventricular and bilateral deep-brain anatomy. The source identifies this as the ADC image of the same four-hour infarction case as the accepted DWI image.
mri_hyperacute_basal_ganglia_infarct_adc.review_caveats: Viewed locally alongside the paired DWI image. No visible identifiers, demographics or text overlays. The source-described lower-ADC region is visible in the image-right basal ganglia region, corresponding qualitatively to the bright DWI lesion. Low source resolution limits fine nuclear or boundary labeling, but permits the paired sequence-signal question. Laterality remains unspecified.
